root_causes_identified.description: Unconditionally appends rec.m15_confirmed_swing_high/low and rec.h1_confirmed_swing_high/low to pool_candidates even after _validate_and_precompute_tf_series already pruned those swept levels from m15_unswept_*/h1_unswept_*.
Invalidates HTF unswept pools only against closed M15/H1 bars, ignoring intervening closed M1 bars strictly between the last HTF close and decision_timestamp_ms that already swept the level.
Alphabetical tie-break ('M15_CONFIRMED_SWING_*' < 'M15_UNSWEPT_SWING_*') assigns CONFIRMED_SWING label even when the level is genuinely still unswept; separated honestly from real swept targets.
